findings.pdf_says: GENERAL FORMAT FOR COMMUNICATION DESCRIPTION ENTRY
findings.why_it_matters: The PDF prints this underlined, centred format heading exactly as on pages 205-207 and 209-214, where the markdown renders it as '## <u>GENERAL FORMAT ...</u>'; on page 208 it is left as plain underlined text with no '##', so the Format 2 and Format 3 CD entries are invisible to heading-based navigation.

findings.pdf_says: SW CLOSE {file-name-1 [ {REEL|UNIT} [FOR REMOVAL] / WITH {NO REWIND|LOCK} ] } ... (one outer brace enclosing file-name-1 and the bracket, ellipsis after the closing brace)
findings.why_it_matters: The drawn figure is malformed: the outer brace carries three middle points on each side (┤ on rows 2, 4 and 6; ├ likewise) and the row holding CLOSE shifts the brace and the bracket out of their columns, so the drawing can read as several stacked braces rather than one brace enclosing file-name-1 and its optional bracket. The words, underlining and ellipsis position survive, but the figure should be redrawn with one outer brace.
